description: University of Antwerp, imec and CrowdScan researchers provide received-signal-strength measurements paired with manual passenger counts at two public-transport platforms. The indoor location is Groenplaats subway station in Antwerp, with four measurement days in 2023. The outdoor location is a tram stop in Barcelona, with three days in 2024. A wireless sensor network records measurement cycles every ten seconds. CSV files hold radio observations and count labels; JSON and GeoJSON files describe sensor positions. Rail-vehicle arrival and departure markers are distinguished from non-negative passenger counts. The Zenodo package is free under CC BY 4.0. Battery changes and limited ground-truth periods constrain calibration. The observations can test occupancy estimators and passenger-demand inputs for station simulations, but do not represent annual ridership. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
